synopsis: Mark Stuart had realized something terrifying: he had been reincarnated as the mid-boss in a game! In the original game, he was fated to be condemned by his daughter, Forsina, who was known as the “Ice Maiden.” Reflecting on his past coldness toward her, he resolves to change his fate by earning her affection. Through his thoughtfulness and his actions as a duke, his daughter begins to regain her love and trust in her father, but he ends up going too far, and her love becomes overwhelmingly heavy, putting him again in danger of getting condemned...!? The World's Strongest Rearguard: Labyrinth Country's Novice Seeker
synopsis: Once, the scariest thing to Arihito Atobe was his workaholic boss, Kyouka Igarashi. Now, this ex–corporate slave faces a world where monster-filled labyrinths are the norm and teamwork is key to survival. While others are eager to charge headlong into battle, Arihito chooses to become a “rearguard”: a class dedicated to helping allies from the back lines. The rearguard gig should be his ticket to avoid repeating his old life, but this opportunity may just shed new light on what it means to support one’s partners and work together! (Source: Yen Press)
